name: betonflow
description: CRM for concrete production planning, traceability and LRT transfers

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @betonflow/api" "npm run dev -w @betonflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @betonflow/domain && npm run build -w @betonflow/api && npm run build -w @betonflow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @betonflow/domain && npm run test -w @betonflow/api && npm run test -w @betonflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @betonflow/domain && npm run typecheck -w @betonflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @betonflow/web
